spans.s: चित्-आत्मन् m. 1. the thinking faculty; 2. the supreme spirit.
चित्-आभास m. the self not freed from impurities.
चित्-उल्लास a. gladdening the mind or heart.
चित्-रूप (I) a. 1. of liberal or expansive mind; 2. consisting of intelligence.
चित्-रूप (II) n. 1. pure intelligence; 2. the supreme being.
